about_short_description.short_description: Blockscope is a Web3 data platform that enables users to capture, analyze, and understand Web3 data.

product.name: Watchtower
product.description: A monitoring tool that provides real-time insights and alerts for on-chain activities, allowing users to create custom filters and templates for tracking blockchain events.

product.name: Tracer
product.description: An investigative tool for tracking token movements across multiple addresses, offering visualizations and comprehensive token tracking to identify suspicious activities.

product.name: Contract Guard
product.description: A collaborative platform for creating and managing custom risk rules to proactively monitor and address potential security threats in blockchain operations.

product.name: Transaction Decoder
product.description: An analytical tool that provides detailed insights into blockchain transactions, including transaction logs, raw trace calls, and visual token transfers.

product.name: Wallet Profiler
product.description: A tool for analyzing crypto wallets, offering insights into wallet holdings, transaction history, and risk assessment to identify potential red flags.
